method.topology: Real Server, PostgreSQL, mTLS, Scheduler and ordinary tool Workers; same compiled test binary and identical capabilities, input bytes and work units.
method.phases: Four scanner children fetch 64 KiB, warm up with 64 hashes, hold for 15 seconds, execute fixed SHA256 work, then hold for 2 seconds before ordinary release.
method.memory: 250 ms samples of Runtime trees including Podman backends and scanner children; PSS, USS (private clean/dirty pages) and RSS are summed once per PID. RSS includes shared pages repeatedly.
method.excluded: Identical Server/driver/origin and existing engine infrastructure. No live model, workload container or retained HTTP body load; HTTP Master remains lazy and the archive cache is enabled but empty.
method.uncertainty: Three alternating-order repetitions by default; min/median/max show variability. Shared VM, CPU frequency, file-page sharing and sampling affect values. No fixed savings or performance threshold.
